fixtureHeader.describes: Stage 1 (init) — captured output of `awsf init`, exactly as it left the command, scrubbed.

fixtureHeader.scrubbed: Per Q7 (2026-08-26): session ids, attempt/task ids and absolute machine paths replaced with stable placeholders; every timestamp normalized to a single fixed instant (2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z), field kept per invariant 1. No other value reformatted, reordered, truncated or tidied from the output as it left its producer.
